question: Pharma excipient invoice from Sai Associates Pvt Ltd, batch in quarantine — does it need QA release?

rule.text: Yes — for Arvana Pharma, an excipient invoice with a batch in Quarantine needs QA release: raise the QA_RELEASE_PENDING exception, owned by Client QA, to be resolved before the due date. [1][2] The rule is that invoices for active pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients and primary packaging material must not be paid until the batch shows status Released in QMS, and this applies to excipients without exception. [1] Check the batch number on the GRN against QMS, and if the batch is in Quarantine or Rejected, raise QA_RELEASE_PENDING. [1] The invoice may be posted, but the payment block stays until release. [1] In practice, colleagues raise QA_RELEASE_PENDING when the QMS shows the batch in Quarantine, and the older FAQ saying excipients don't need release is ignored. [3]

question: Infra invoice from Vertex Enterprises has no GRN since Saturday, should I raise NO_GRN now?

rule.text: Not yet: hold the invoice as NO_GRN and let the system notify the requester automatically, since a goods invoice with no GRN must be held under that code. [1] The system sends a reminder after two working days and escalates to the requester's manager after five working days, and the invoice must not be posted against a PO without a GRN whatever the requester says on the phone. [1] The Requester owns NO_GRN resolution, with a target to resolve of 5 working days. [2] In practice, Infra sites batch their GRNs on Monday morning, so anything that came in Friday to Sunday is waited on until Tuesday noon before raising NO_GRN. [3][4]

question: Is INV/0605 same as INV715-REV from Kaveri Foods Pvt Ltd?

rule.text: No — once normalised, INV/0605 becomes INV605 and INV715-REV becomes INV715, so the two invoice numbers are not the same. [1] The rule in force removes spaces, slashes, hyphens and leading zeros, and drops a trailing suffix of /A, /R or -REV before comparison. [1] They are still a suspected duplicate if the supplier GSTIN and normalised number match, or if the supplier, invoice date and total amount (within ₹1) match. [1] Any suspected duplicate goes to the exception queue as DUP_SUSPECT and is never posted until a Senior Processor clears it. [1] In practice, suppliers resend invoices all the time, including revised copies, and if the check flags amber you stop. [2]

question: Metro Agencies Pvt Ltd wants to change bank account, they mailed from their registered id. Can I send for approval?

rule.text: Not yet — an e-mail from the registered id is not enough: the supplier must send a request on letterhead signed by an authorised signatory, with a cancelled cheque for the new account. [10] In practice, if the request gives a different phone number or asks you to call someone else, do not call it — log the request as suspicious and tell the AP Controller. [11][12]
